data_objects.name: trajectory_poi_visits
data_objects.meaning: User trajectory records at point-of-interest visit granularity, with visit times, photo counts, trajectory length, and visit duration.
data_objects.notes: Rows belonging to the same trajID form a repeated sequence for one user, but physical row order within every trajectory is not guaranteed to be chronological.

variables.name: userID
variables.meaning: User account identifier associated with the trajectory.

variables.name: trajID
variables.meaning: Trajectory identifier grouping point-of-interest visits for one user.

variables.name: startTime
variables.meaning: Visit start timestamp encoded as Unix-style epoch seconds.

variables.name: endTime
variables.meaning: Visit end timestamp encoded in the same epoch convention as startTime.

variables.name: #photo
variables.meaning: Number of photos associated with the point-of-interest visit.

variables.name: trajLen
variables.meaning: Number of point-of-interest visit rows in the trajectory, repeated across its rows.

variables.name: poiDuration
variables.meaning: Elapsed visit duration represented by endTime minus startTime.

structure.description: Each row is one point-of-interest visit. trajID groups visits into a trajectory associated with one userID, and trajLen matches the number of rows in that group.
The tuple of trajID, poiID, startTime, and endTime distinguishes visit rows; timestamps rather than physical row position express within-trajectory chronology.
poiDuration is the interval from startTime through endTime, expressed in seconds.

uncertainties: The timestamp timezone and the semantic criteria used to delimit trajectories and point-of-interest visits are not documented.
The geographic identities represented by poiID are not included.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
